div.div: 10 استورأتِ الإِبِلُ The camels took fright and ran away, in a body, one after another: (As:) accord. to AZ, this is said when they have taken fright and ascended a mountain; but if they have taken fright and run away in a plain, one says استأورت: so in the dial. of the tribe of 'Okeyl. [Thus in the TA in this art.: but see إِسْتَؤَرتْ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
